title: Machine learning and online tests identify autistic adults with 92% accuracy
Machine learning and online tests identify autistic adults with 92% accuracy
description: Diagnosing autism in adults can be difficult due to long wait times. A new study shows that combining a standard questionnaire with online mental tests and artificial intelligence can predict an autism diagnosis with 92% accuracy.
